scope: Two-line aggregate-only receipt addition. No final source selection, publisher/CI/build/cleanup admission, current metric value, actual publication or final completion accepted.

retained_v1.use: Reuse complete v1/C19 body and five-path binding review; do not repeat unaffected source/actual audits.

independent_text_proof.method: Ordinary literal byte/string and unified-diff comparison only; candidate not imported, AST-parsed, compiled or executed.

semantics.location: Immediately after existing actual full committed-tree parse/equality check and before existing commit receipt update/repeated remote comparison/push. No Git argv or ordering changed.
semantics.N: len(whole), the complete already-verified committed-tree path-map member count, including inherited members and final selected/companion paths.
semantics.Q: Sum of UTF-8 byte lengths of json.dumps(path, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(comma,colon)) string literals. Includes quotes and escapes. ensure_ascii is TRUE, not raw Unicode/path length.
semantics.max_json_quoted_path_bytes: Maximum of the same encoded JSON string-literal lengths, not raw path length or maximum source-file size.
semantics.nonempty: Existing mandatory five selected afterimages and complete committed-tree equality guarantee a nonempty whole map before max().
semantics.bounds_and_privacy: Only in-memory path-map traversal and three aggregate integers plus fixed qualification text are added. Existing input/output/file/inventory/resource/deadline/receipt caps remain. No member payload, path list, new probe, ls-tree -l, capture or helper is added.
semantics.limits: No raw source-byte total, largest member size, -l metrics, source/index capture result, semantic coverage or publication success is inferred. Full map, not selected rows alone, is the prospective source of these aggregates.

future_binding: Only an original separately admitted root invocation and independently reconciled actual/terminal evidence may bind actual N/Q/max values for a specifically stated capture-capacity calculation. Field definitions are not live measurements or admission. All v1 final selection/positive B-leaf privacy/material, T/current-index release, workflow/branchPR, config/slot/protected-ref/context/resource/instance gates remain unbound here.
preservation: All five afterimage literals, strict config/object/index/sole-parent/remote/lock/whitespace checks, no-removal restriction, <=450 bound, no automatic retry, consumed/HOLD/refusal/STOP/NO-RETRY/CLOSED and occupied1017001 boundaries are byte-unchanged. No count or closure change.
activity: Read only the named inert v1/v2 proposal/data/patch bytes, performed standard-library text/hash/JSON comparisons, and wrote this new own-lane review with exact readback. No Git/T/network/process/runtime/SDK/source capture or helper/project execution/import/AST/compile, build/test/CI, patch application, cleanup, central edit, subagent or background work.
